svg.text: talk.01 · CONCEPT C — RADIO
Rotary band dial · slide-latch lever · ring grille · bail stand / carry loop
TENTATIVE · NOT A FINAL DESIGN
original concept · dimensions are guesses · 2026-11-25
10 mm
FRONT
REAR · stand closed
SIDE · lever side
SIDE · stand open, on desk

g.text: stand: U-frame bail 72 mm long; a 2nd detent (~45°, not drawn) would aim higher
opens ~45° from the body, body leans 28° back from vertical
balance: centre of mass 12 mm behind the pivot

svg.text: CONTROLS (numbers match the callouts)
1 mic port: single hole in the centre of the ring grille
2 slide lever, left edge: push down = talk; click on = latch
3 rotary band dial: DICT / TALK / OPEN (clicks, visible)
4 status lamp (also shows mute / latched)
5 optional buzzer holes
6 USB-C, right edge: cable runs to the laptop
7 bail stand, also a carry loop 8 rubber feet
+ WHY IT MIGHT WORK
Rotary band dial is the most radio-like; mode is tactile
One lever covers momentary AND hands-free (latch)
Bail stand doubles as a lanyard / carry loop
Ring grille is original (segmented rings)
- TRADEOFFS / RISKS
Most mechanics: dial + latch slider + bail: more tuning
Rotary switch must be panel-mount: needs ~20 mm depth
Latch is an extra mode: more firmware states to test
Ring grille is decorative; real port is one small hole
Round dial + side lever: keep it from reading as a TE copy
